//: Build profiles. Each one decides which environment the build belongs to by setting CALDER_ENV, which app.config.ts turns into the API base URL that ships in the bundle.

cli.//appVersionSource: Expo tracks the build number rather than the repository, so two builds from one commit do not collide and nobody has to remember to bump app.json.

development.//: A dev client on a device or simulator, talking to dev.

preview.//: A release build without the dev client, still pointed at dev. This is the alpha shape: what a tester installs, before there is a prod environment to point anything at.

production.//: Store and TestFlight builds. Pointed at prod, which does not exist yet, and cannot be built at all until there is an Apple Developer account behind it.
